description:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

CRA's European Competition Practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings: firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid. We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. We offer assistance on the estimation of effects and damages in cartel cases, international arbitration and intellectual property disputes.

For more information on the Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in Europe visit http://ecp.crai.com.

Position Overview

Principals have the unique opportunity to learn from, and work alongside, some of the most respected scholars, specialists, and industry experts in the world.  We tailor our analyses to the facts of each case, employing tools such as merger simulation, upward pricing pressure analysis, econometrics, bargaining theory, or game theory as needed. Whether before a court or a regulatory agency, CRA consultants set a high standard for the clear communication of sophisticated economic analysis in complex cases. You will have access to internal training programs focused on creative problem solving, communications, and leading and managing colleagues, teams and cases.  In addition, our firm offers extracurricular activities where you can take additional leadership roles in recruiting, training, and volunteer activities in the local community.

A typical Principal would:

  • Work closely with leading academics and consulting with attorneys and other clients in industry and government on a wide variety of finance, strategy and economics issues;
  • Act as a primary point of contact for clients and assist in the development and presentation of client deliverables including expert reports summarizing our opinions, conclusions, and recommendations and third party financial, market and industry data;
  • Independently conceptualize and identify issues, design complex economic and financial models to analyze economic and financial data;
  • Manage the research process, and supervising, training and mentoring junior analysts;
  • Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions;
  • Work with those testifying in judicial proceedings to provide economic analyses of mergers and other competition matters before the major competition authorities of the world;
  • Assist with recruiting and training of new colleagues.

Desired Qualifications

  • Strong achievement in a graduate degree program (Masters or PhD) with focused study in economics or another quantitative discipline;
  • Extensive and relevant experience (7-11 years), preferably economics/antitrust consulting experience preferred;
  • Demonstrated understanding of economic concepts, competition/regulatory authorities and quantitative and qualitative analysis methods;
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills;
  • Experience managing and developing teams of junior colleagues;
  • Executive client presence and interaction skills. 

To Apply

To be considered for this position, submit through this job posting:

  • Curriculum Vitae – please include current address, email and telephone number;
  • Covering letter – please describe your interest in a role with CRA's Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in London and how this role matches your goals.  

 

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Diversity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (Equality Act 2010). As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

The statements included in this job description are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. What We're Looking For We're looking for a Technical Project Manager who runs our hardware development projects end to end and holds the thread between our engineers, our external partners, and our leadership. Our system combines optics, mechanics, electronics, and embedded control with machine learning on top. Most of what you manage is hardware, but every hardware decision touches software and data science, and you make sure those pieces move together. Development happens in-house, but parts of it are outsourced to production partners and component suppliers. You keep those external work packages aligned with our internal timelines, specifications, and quality standards. Our Sales Engineering team owns the customer relationship; you make sure their requirements turn into delivered systems. You take ownership end to end, hold yourself to a high standard, and focus on outcomes that matter for the customer. You communicate openly, give honest feedback, and build trust through your actions. Fluent German is a strong plus for working with our partners and suppliers Willingness to travel occasionally to our partners Nice to have: experience with embedded systems, optics, or agile product ownership Not ticking every box? Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Zo combineren we de voordelen van een groot bedrijf met de warme, persoonlijke sfeer van kleinschaliger teams: de waardestromen. Bij ons heerst een informele sfeer met een typisch Rotterdamse mentaliteit: hard werken, maar ook hard lachen. As a backend engineer, you'd play a critical role in our search architecture. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests. Search quality is bounded by what we understand about a page. Before anything can be retrieved, something has to work out what the page actually says. That means parsing it into the parts that are content and the parts that are furniture, classifying what kind of page it is and what it is about, telling whether the page is usable at all, extracting when it was published, judging how good it is and whether it can be trusted, and working out whether it says anything that a page we already have does not. All of this has to work on every page on the web, in every language, in every shape the web comes in. Some of this is classic document understanding. Some of it is much more open. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them. We are looking for a research engineer to work on this. There is a lot of room to do it well. Desired Experience Graduate-level ML experience (Master’s or PhD with at least 2 years of relevant experience), or an exceptionally strong undergrad You can build a transformer from scratch in PyTorch, and you have trained models that then had to be cheap enough to run everywhere You like building large-scale datasets and living in the data. Most of the wins here are in the supervision rather than the architecture You are comfortable with problems where the ground truth does not exist yet and defining it is part of the job You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world Example Projects Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately Build classification and extraction that is accurate at web scale and cheap enough to run on all of it Design the supervision for something nobody has labels for, and find out whether it is learnable at all Trace a bad search result back to the page-level prediction that caused it, and fix it at the source Exa is an equal opportunity employer. Actief bijdragen aan de groei en ontwikkeling van de adviesgroep door jouw commerciële vaardigheden en netwerk. Quote ‘Overheden staan voor complexe financiële uitdagingen. Senior DevSecOps Engineer

Location: London | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Build the platforms that power secure, intelligent and scalable enterprise engineering.

The Role

At Capco, we're looking for a Senior DevSecOps Engineer to help design, build and modernise enterprise software delivery capabilities for leading financial services organisations.

You'll play a key role in developing a modern enterprise Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) platform, with a focus on CI/CD automation, policy-as-code, security controls and cloud-native engineering.

This is a hands-on engineering opportunity where you'll translate architecture into production-ready capabilities, integrate complex enterprise technologies and support engineering teams in adopting scalable, secure delivery practices.

You'll also explore approved AI-enabled engineering tools and workflows to improve development productivity, automation and delivery quality, while maintaining appropriate human oversight, security controls and responsible AI practices.

What You’ll Do

  • Build modern CI/CD platforms: Design, develop and implement enterprise GitLab SaaS CI/CD pipelines, reusable engineering patterns and automated workflows, leveraging approved AI-assisted engineering capabilities where appropriate to improve efficiency and quality.
  • Embed security and governance: Implement policy-as-code, automated security and quality gates, change controls, SAST, DAST, secrets management and vulnerability management throughout the SDLC.
  • Engineer cloud-native solutions: Build and integrate services across Azure, Kubernetes and Azure API Management, supporting application, cloud and data workloads, including Snowflake and Salesforce.
  • Modernise enterprise engineering environments: Support migrations from legacy Jenkins, GitLab, SonarQube, Artifactory/Nexus and AWS environments, integrating observability capabilities using Grafana and Prometheus.
  • Enable engineering teams: Translate target architecture into working production capabilities, develop reusable platform services and onboard engineering teams, promoting responsible AI-enabled workflows with appropriate review, auditability and human decision-making.

What We’re Looking For

  • GitLab and Azure expertise: Extensive hands-on experience designing, building and operating enterprise GitLab CI/CD pipelines and Azure-based engineering solutions.
  • Cloud-native engineering: Strong practical experience with Kubernetes, DevSecOps principles, infrastructure automation and policy-as-code.
  • Security and governance integration: Experience embedding identity, security controls, automated testing, quality gates and compliance requirements into enterprise delivery pipelines.
  • Enterprise modernisation: Demonstrated experience modernising complex engineering environments, integrating multiple technologies and delivering scalable, production-ready platform capabilities.
  • Technical leadership and delivery: Ability to take architectural designs through implementation, collaborate with engineering teams and support knowledge transfer, with an interest in applying approved AI tools and automation responsibly to improve engineering outcomes.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience integrating Azure API Management with cloud-native platforms and enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with Snowflake, Salesforce and engineering patterns supporting data-intensive workloads.
  • Experience migrating from Jenkins, SonarQube, Artifactory/Nexus or AWS-based engineering environments.
  • Knowledge of Grafana, Prometheus and enterprise observability practices.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools or AI-enabled DevSecOps workflows, with an understanding of responsible AI, human review and appropriate security guardrails.

Why Join Capco

  • Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions.
  • Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.
  • Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications.
  • Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services.
  • Help shape the future of digital transformation across FS & Energy.

Benefits

We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life:

  • Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.
  • Mental Health: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations, and in-house first aiders.
  • Family-Friendly: Maternity, adoption, shared parental leave, plus paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause, and bereavement.
  • Family Care: 8 complimentary backup care sessions for emergency childcare or elder care.
  • Holiday Flexibility: 5 weeks of annual leave with the option to buy or sell holiday days based on your needs.
  • Continuous Learning: Your growth, your way – minimum 40 hours of training annually. Take your pick: workshops, certifications, e-learning. Plus, a Business Coach assigned from Day One to provide one-on-one guidance to support your goals and development.
  • Healthcare Access: Convenient online GP services.
  • Extra Perks: Gympass (Wellhub), travel insurance, Tastecard, season ticket loans, Cycle to Work, and dental insurance.

Inclusion at Capco

We're committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we'll be happy to help.

We value each person's unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day. 

#LI-DNI

description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About the Team

Fanatics Collectibles is the home of sports cards, trading cards, and collectibles for over 100 million fans worldwide. As part of the global Fanatics platform, we're rebuilding how collectors discover, buy, sell, and experience their hobby — live, in real time, at scale.

Our flagship mobile product, Fanatics Live, is where that experience comes to life: live card breaks, real-time auctions, high-traffic chat, marketplace transactions, and deep collection management tools. The stakes are high and the traffic is real — we build for peak-load moments where latency is visible and reliability is nonnegotiable.

Role Summary

You'll join the Instant Rips iOS team — the group responsible for the live-break commerce experience on Fanatics Live. We build the surfaces millions of collectors use in real time: bidding in live auctions, joining breaks, navigating a high-velocity chat stream, and transacting in the marketplace.

The iOS stack is modern by design. We're SwiftUI-first, run The Composable Architecture TCA) across the app, use Swift Concurrency throughout, talk to our backend via Apollo GraphQL, and maintain a clean modular SPM codebase generated with Tuist. There's no legacy UIKit app hiding under the surface — you'll be working in a codebase you can be proud of.

AI tooling is part of how we work. We expect engineers to use it on the job, give it good context, and verify the output — not just accept it.

What you'll do

  • Design and ship production iOS features across the live-break experience: auctions, stream viewing, chat, marketplace, and collector tools
  • Own features end-to-end — API contracts, TCA reducers, SwiftUI views, testing, and release
  • Write genuine test coverage: unit tests with mock dependencies, TCA
  • TestStore assertions, async test patterns — not coverage theater
  • Review pull requests with judgment: surface real defects, prioritize what matters, coach on what to let go
  • Contribute to architectural decisions: modularization strategy, effect management, failure handling
  • Mentor engineers earlier in their career and raise the quality bar across the team

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years building consumer-facing iOS applications at scale
  • Hands-on with AI-assisted development tooling LLM optimization loops, Xcode CLI integration)
  • Swift Concurrency — async/await, structured concurrency, Sendable, Swift Macros
  • SwiftUI — stateless/stateful view patterns, NavigationStack, performanceaware composition
  • The Composable Architecture TCA — Reducer/Store/Action/State, effect management, parent-child delegation, testing with TestStore
  • Apollo GraphQL (iOS) — schema-driven development, Swift codegen, subscriptions
  • SPM multi-package architecture — modular feature separation, local packages, clean dependency graphs
  • Tuist or XcodeGen — project generation tooling; no committed .xcodeproj CI/CD — Bitrise, Fastlane, or equivalent automated build/test pipelines Static analysis — SwiftLint, Periphery or equivalent code quality gates
  • Structured commit/PR discipline tied to a project tracker Linear, Jira, or equivalent)

Bonus points

  • Experience with livestreaming, real-time auctions, or high-throughput WebSocket/subscription workloads
  • Exposure to marketplace or e-commerce iOS applications
  • Passion for sports cards, collectibles, or live commerce

 

The above list of job duties is not exclusive or exhaustive and the post holder will be required to undertake such tasks as may reasonably be expected within the scope and grading of the post.

title: Senior Key Account Manager

description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Our EMEA Key Account Management Team is growing and we want you to be part of it! 

The EMEA Key Accounts team manages the partnerships with Regional API Software providers and Enterprise Property Managers. The key goal is to grow the share of high quality stays by optimising supply at scale leveraging strategic account management, programs, incentives,  and product solutions. 

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Senior Key Accounts Manager, you will be managing partner relationships with strategic Enterprises & API Connectivity partners. You will be responsible for recruitment, enablement and optimization of our strategic partnerships and become their trusted advisor with the aim to become their number one partner and accelerate growth and performance on both sides. You will be reporting to the Key Accounts Team Lead, EMEA.

This role is based in Paris (hybrid, 2-3 days a week in the office), and is not eligible for relocation support.

A typical day: 

  • Own a portfolio of Airbnb’s key partners and act as the key representative for these partners. 
  • Execute a global win-win strategy for your portfolio that drives value to all parties and positions Airbnb as a top strategic partner across all distribution channels. 
  • Develop strong and trusting relationships with executives and decision makers/key influencers within your API & Enterprise customers portfolio, ensure that the partnership is held to the highest industry standards and that commercial agreements as well as SLAs are met.
  • Analyze data and utilize data-driven recommendations to identify and action on strategic growth opportunities 
  • Work with quarterly goals, measure success against performance KPIs, feature adoption and supply acquisition growth.
  • Support partners through deep understanding of API and technical integrations 
  • Educate clients on our product roadmap and all significant product changes to accelerate feature adoption with the aim to excel our mutual guest experience 
  • Represent Airbnb in external meetings and industry events 

Your expertise: 

  • 8+ years of professional experience in Strategic Partnership, Key Account Management and/or Connectivity role at a global technology or tech hospitality company
  • Fluent verbal/written communication and presentation skills in both English and French
  • Exceptional stakeholder management across both internal and external audiences
  • Experience with API integrations a plus
  • World class account management experience with strong track record of successfully growing a book of business/geographic area and building enduring and successful client relationships
  • Experience in the hospitality technology space, knowledge of OTA specifications
  • Experience in analyzing, structuring and negotiating complex deals that align across multiple business unit needs
  • Extremely data driven in the decision-making process to ensure timely, impactful and accurate actions are taken.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with product, tech, legal, marketing, sales operations and enablement teams.
  • Ability to manage complex projects and multi-task with excellent organizational skills, in a fast-paced, dynamic and ever changing startup environment.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to effectively influence top leaders internally and within the industry. 
  • Passion for Airbnb, travel, and the sharing economy
  • Previous experience as product manager, working with product teams is a plus
  • Ability to travel at least 25% of the time 

 

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

 

 

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

France Annual Pay Range
€74.000—€92.000 EUR

 

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The Senior Key Corporate Sales Manager is responsible for developing and executing Lucid Motors’ European B2B sales strategy, driving sustainable growth across key accounts, enterprise customers, leasing companies, rental operators, and fleet and mobility partners.

This role identifies new business opportunities, develops strategic partnerships, negotiates commercial agreements, and delivers sales, revenue, and profitability targets. The role also leads and develops a team of Corporate Sales Managers and supports Lucid’s importer markets to ensure consistent execution across Europe.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Business Development

  • Identify, develop, and secure new business opportunities with enterprise customers, corporate fleets, leasing companies, rental operators, and mobility providers.
  • Position Lucid as a preferred premium electric vehicle partner and develop strategic account plans that support sustainable growth.

Sales Strategy & Commercial Performance

  • Develop and execute the European corporate sales strategy in line with Lucid’s growth objectives.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop competitive vehicle, financing, and service propositions.
  • Deliver sales, revenue, profitability, and market share targets.

Strategic Account & Partnership Management

  • Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers at major corporate accounts and strategic partners.
  • Understand customer fleet and mobility requirements and provide tailored commercial solutions.
  • Manage relationships with leasing, rental, fleet, mobility, and importer partners across Europe.

Commercial Negotiations

  • Lead complex negotiations and contract discussions with strategic customers and partners.
  • Structure commercial agreements that create long-term value for Lucid and its customers.

Market Intelligence & Reporting

  • Monitor industry trends, competitor activity, fleet market developments, and emerging mobility solutions.
  • Provide regular performance reporting, customer insights, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

Leadership & Customer Experience

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Corporate Sales Managers.
  • Promote accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and commercial excellence.
  • Ensure a consistent premium customer and partner experience throughout the sales lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in automotive B2B sales, fleet sales, corporate sales, key account management, or mobility solutions.
  • Proven experience developing business and managing strategic accounts across multiple European markets.
  • Strong knowledge of fleet sales, leasing, financing, electric vehicles, total cost of ownership, and mobility trends.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering revenue growth, profitability, market share, and customer retention.
  • Proven experience leading and developing high-performing sales teams.
  • Experience negotiating complex commercial agreements and strategic partnerships.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, supported by a data-driven approach.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience with CRM and sales performance systems; Salesforce experience is preferred.
  • Results-oriented and entrepreneurial, with a strong interest in innovation and electric mobility.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are advantageous.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
 

Lucid Motors is committed to maintaining a safe and trustworthy environment. As such, a background check may be required during the hiring process. This will be performed in line with European data protection laws, and candidates will be informed and asked to provide consent before the check is conducted.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.  

Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations. 

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at . This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. 

To all recruitment agencies: Lucid Motors does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Lucid Motors. Lucid Motors is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Homes Supply team plays a critical role in ensuring Airbnb secures a diverse and high-quality supply of stays listings. Efforts are aimed at meeting the expectations of guests by ensuring a wide offering of high-quality listings at compelling values are available for every search.

The Difference You will Make:

In this role, you will lead a team of Market Associates responsible for a high-velocity, input-driven account management motion supporting our long tail of Small/medium sized Hosts. You will own execution excellence across rapid optimisation workflows, holding the team accountable to activity-based KPIs while driving consistent, scalable impact across the region.

You will also serve as a key stakeholder and operator for all scaled supply acquisition and retention initiatives within your assigned territory. This includes organising and executing regional roadshows and events, developing strategies to grow and retain supply, and rapidly scaling best practices across the team. The role partners closely with Host Services and Community teams to ensure seamless delivery, strong host engagement, and measurable outcomes.

This role plays a critical role in driving host quality, supply performance, and campaign effectiveness at scale.

A Typical Day: 

  • Lead and manage a team of Market Associates executing a high-volume, transactional optimisation motion, with a strong focus on input-based KPIs that drive improvements in listing performance, host quality, and overall supply health.
  • Be accountable for regional business performance, including input and output metrics, supply optimisation results and host quality KPIs.

Serve as an active stakeholder and operator across all scaled outreach initiatives, partnering closely with Host Services and Community teams to ensure campaigns, roadshows, and regional events are delivered consistently, efficiently, and at scale.

  • Monitor performance dashboards and scaled campaign results, identify trends or gaps, and adjust team focus to improve outcomes.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks, tooling gaps, or process inefficiencies and partner cross-functionally to improve scale, speed, and consistency.
  • Coach and develop team members to excel in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment while preparing high performers for future growth opportunities.
  • Continually test, refine, and standardise scaled account motions and best practices, codifying what works and rapidly rolling it out across the team.
  • May help design, launch, and scale targeted outreach campaigns for Solo and Small Hosts—partnering cross-functionally
  • Build new communication channels to increase reach, engagement and impact within this cohort

Your Expertise:

  • 3-5+ years relevant experience managing teams, preferably scaled account management teams, with a strong interest in people management and team development.
  • Prior experience in operations, sales or leading projects in a performance-driven environment. 
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, high-volume workflows with clear metrics and performance goals.
  • Strong organisational and program execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities at once.
  • Data-oriented mindset with the ability to use dashboards and insights to guide decisions and coaching.
  • Clear and confident communicator who can translate strategy into actionable guidance for frontline teams.
  • Ability to partner cross-functionally and follow through on shared goals.
  • Some Marketing experience is a plus.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

United Kingdom Annual Pay Range
£72,000—£85,000 GBP

 

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

  • Du managst den gesamten Content-Workflow von der Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung und koordinierst interne sowie externe Content-Writer:innen für eine termingerechte Umsetzung

  • Du trägst zum Aufbau eines Netzwerks aus glaubwürdigen Partner:innen (Institutionen, Expert:innen, medizinische Fachgesellschaften) bei, um die Autorität von Doctolibs Gesundheitsinhalten zu stärken

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

  • Abschluss in Kommunikation, Journalismus oder Lebenswissenschaften (Biomedizin, Public Health o.ä.)
  • Mindestens 4 Jahre nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Bereich Medical Content Writing, Gesundheitskommunikation oder verwandten Feldern

description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As we grow the organisation, hiring the best people becomes one of our main priorities. To be able to successfully do that, we need to keep evolving: adjusting and improving our hiring processes, ensuring quality in everything that we do and creating new ways of working. This is why the successful performance of our Talent Acquisition (TA) team is highly important.

As a Senior TA Specialist, you will contribute to reaching the team’s main goal: attracting and employing the right talent for Vinted, while ensuring a great candidate experience. You will do this by applying your strong hiring competencies, effectively partnering with your Hiring Managers, leveraging innovative approaches, implementing best hiring practices, and collaborating with other teams on various projects.

You’ll support either our Group & Marketplace business units, covering Community Support, Marketing, Finance, Legal and People, or our Vinted Pay & VintedGo business units, covering AML/Compliance, Business & Commercial and Logistics, with your focus shifting based on business needs.

If you're excited to contribute to our team's efforts in supporting our organisation's growth, we would love to meet you.

Note. This role is offered as a 12-months fixed-term contract initially. There may be an opportunity for the position to be made permanent in the future, depending on business needs. 

In this position, you’ll 

  • Partner with hiring managers to define hiring strategies, prioritise critical hiring needs, and shape recruitment processes for best results
  • Lead the end-to-end recruitment process, including job posting, proactive candidate sourcing, conducting interviews, and extending offers; including senior-level as well as highly specialised roles
  • At times you may work in close partnership with the Talent Acquisition Support Specialists to maintain hiring alignment, ensure efficient assessment and selection processes, deliver hiring objectives, and provide ongoing mentoring support
  • Act as a strategic advisor to stakeholders, providing expertise on recruitment best practices, assessment methods, sharing market insights, and upskilling Hiring Manager competencies 
  • Drive initiatives to improve diversity and inclusion within the hiring process
  • Identify opportunities to drive innovation in talent acquisition, including new strategies, tools, and processes to enhance hiring and team performance
  • Use data-driven insights to track, analyse, and report on hiring metrics, creating strategies to improve time-to-hire, quality of hire, candidate experience and wider TA goals
  • Conduct proactive market mapping to build talent pipelines, understand competitor landscape, and support future hiring delivery
  • Analyse inefficiencies in the hiring process, identify opportunities for enhancement, and lead process improvements in the recruitment workflow to align with and support the goals of a growing organisation
  • Lead talent acquisition-related projects, including process improvement, recruitment marketing campaigns, and technology implementation
  • Stay updated on recruitment trends and innovative candidate evaluation tools to maintain a competitive edge in talent acquisition

About you 

  • You will have proven experience as a Talent Acquisition Specialist or Recruiter 
  • You are proficient in proactive sourcing candidates and creating talent pipelines using LinkedIn and other recruitment tools
  • You have proven experience partnering with senior stakeholders and hiring Managers at all levels, with the ability to coach and influence toward better hiring outcomes
  • You have strong interviewing and candidate assessment skills
  • You have the ability to mentor and coach members of the team, supporting their professional development and growth
  • You have the ability to analyse and interpret data, identify trends and communicate hiring recommendations to Hiring Managers for data-driven hiring decisions
  • Strong skills in candidate engagement and relationship building
  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate across teams and level

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance 
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

description: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01 Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. Iemand die meedenkt over procedures, voorbereiding van de commissioning en startup en helpt om operators klaar te stomen voor het moment waarop de installatie daadwerkelijk gaat draaien. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten. Over de functie Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES. Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar): Werk je in dagdienst Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01 Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek. In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028): Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators in een 5-ploegendienst binnen een volcontinu productieproces. Bewaak je de veilige en efficiënte productie van SAF, propaan, butaan en nafta. Monitor je procesprestaties via DCS- en MES-systemen, stuur je bij waar nodig en zorg je ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits- en rendementsdoelstellingen worden gerealiseerd. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het naleven van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsstandaarden, neem je de leiding bij incidenten en calamiteiten en coördineer je werkzaamheden tussen Operations, Maintenance en andere betrokken disciplines. Ook speel je een actieve rol in het continu verbeteren van processen en het verder versterken van de veiligheidscultuur binnen de fabriek. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het ontwikkelen van het operationele team. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei van operators, zowel op technisch vlak als in competenties zoals samenwerking, eigenaarschap en veiligheidsbewustzijn. Door coaching, begeleiding en duidelijke verwachtingen zorg je voor een sterk team dat veilig, effectief en met vertrouwen kan opereren. Jouw profiel SkyNRG is een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en voelt je op je plek in een omgeving die continu in beweging is. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende: Ervaring en affiniteit met Procestechniek, Chemische Technologie of een vergelijkbare richting Minimaal een afgeronde VAPRO C of AOT niveau 4-opleiding Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring binnen de chemische, petrochemische, raffinage- of vergelijkbare procesindustrie Aantoonbare operationele leidinggevende ervaring en bewezen people development skills Ervaring met procesautomatisering en het werken met DCS- en MES-systemen Kennis van procesveiligheid, werkvergunningensystemen en relevante wet- en regelgeving Ervaring met het nemen van operationele beslissingen in situaties waar veiligheid, kwaliteit en continuïteit samenkomen Welkome extra kennis en ervaring: Ervaring binnen greenfield-projecten of grootschalige industriële bouw- en opstartprojecten Ervaring met commissioning, startup en operational readiness Kennis van raffinage-, hydroprocessing- of duurzame brandstofprocessen Ervaring met continue verbeterprogramma's en performance management Over DSL-01 In Delfzijl bouwen wij aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta. DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten. De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart. We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal. Waarom deze rol? Deze functie biedt een kans die maar weinig operators en shift supervisors krijgen. Je bent vanaf een vroeg stadium betrokken bij de realisatie van een compleet nieuwe fabriek en kunt jouw operationele expertise inzetten om invloed uit te oefenen op commissioning, procedures, opleidingen en de uiteindelijke manier van werken. Na de opstart maak je de stap naar een operationele omgeving waarin je leiding geeft aan een moderne productie-installatie en een belangrijke rol speelt in het neerzetten van de standaarden, cultuur en prestaties van de fabriek. Tegelijkertijd draag je direct bij aan de realisatie van een van Europa's eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken. Een unieke kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuwe productieorganisatie én een tastbare bijdrage te leveren aan de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart. NB: Voor de opbouw van de operationele organisatie zoeken we uiteindelijk vijf Shift Supervisors. De eerste twee Supervisors starten tijdens de project- en opstartfase van DSL-01. De overige drie posities worden naar verwachting in het voorjaar ingevuld, zodat het volledige team gereed is voor de operationele fase. ‌ Solliciteer Wil jij meewerken aan de succesvolle realisatie van een nieuwe fabriek en het resultaat van je werk terugzien in de praktijk? Dan is dit je kans om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van duurzame luchtvaart. NB: Een medische keuring maakt vanwege veiligheids- en gezondheidsredenen onderdeel uit van de selectieprocedure voor deze functie. ‌ Meer weten over DSL-01 en SkyNRG? Kijk op www.skynrg.com. 📌 Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. SkyNRG is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We zetten ons in voor een inclusieve werkomgeving en beoordelen alle sollicitanten op basis van hun kwaliteiten, ongeacht afkomst, huidskleur, religie, nationaliteit, geslacht, seksuele oriëntatie, genderidentiteit of -expressie, leeftijd, beperking of andere wettelijk beschermde kenmerken. description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on. What you'll do Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down. Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan. Make it fast at scale: serve thousands of queries per second, profiling and cutting p50/p99 latency, memory and cost per query under high concurrent load, from on-disk layout to network fan-out. Keep answers consistent while the data converges: the graph is fed by live updates and bulk snapshots at once and is eventually consistent by design, so you'll own what a query may see while it converges: consistent snapshot promotion, ordered application of live updates and stable pagination across versions. Measure precision and completeness: end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found. What we're looking for You've worked deep inside a distributed database, query engine, search engine or storage system. Strong grasp of indexing, query planning and optimization, and storage formats. Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, replication, sharding and fault tolerance. Strong in a systems language (Go, Rust or C++). You profile before you optimize, and you've shipped measured latency wins in production. You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale. Bonus Graph databases, or combining vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval Compilers, query language design or cost-based optimizers Example projects Build a system that retrieves and reasons over everything known about any company or person in the world, answering any factual question precisely and completely. Answer precise multi-hop questions over hundreds of billions of claims at thousands of QPS with interactive latency. Build a planner that picks the right mix of graph, vector, full-text and geospatial retrieval for any question, and proves it chose well. Make new knowledge queryable seconds after it's synthesized, without ever serving an inconsistent result. Logistics Location: This is an in-person opportunity in Zurich. Visas: We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). While we cannot guarantee your visa, we have historically been successful in sponsoring candidates from all over the world. If you receive an offer, our team will work hard to get you a visa. Benefits: We offer premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), fertility benefits, 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees. description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

As Staff Engineer, you'll own the architecture, agents and skills that let every builder in your tribe ship sound, well-architected work without waiting on a handoff, at a moment when Mews has moved almost entirely to an agentic-first engineering model. The problem this role exists to solve is easy to state and hard to do: most technical decisions now get made by builders and the agents they run, not by senior engineers in review, so the standard has to be built into the tooling itself or the gaps show up in what customers touch. Mews is rebuilding hospitality software from the ground up at a genuinely unusual pace, which makes this one of the few staff engineering roles where the leverage you build gets used by everyone around you within weeks.

You'll be attached to one tribe, reporting into its Director, and working alongside other staff engineers, staff product managers and staff designers across your division. Your job isn't to ship features. It's to produce the architecture, agents and skills that give every builder in the tribe the context to make sound calls on their own, and to stay hands-on with the hardest problems yourself: the gnarly migrations and system-wide refactors that need an approach invented rather than executed.

As Mews moves builders to own a sub-metric end-to-end, with AI covering what they're lighter in, the risk isn't slower shipping, it's the architecture fragmenting underneath the speed. This role exists so the foundations get stronger as the tribe ships faster, not shakier.

What you would do 

  • Own the tribe's engineering context, agents and skills, and be accountable for keeping them coherent, current and grounded in real product work
  • Build and evaluate the internal engineering agents and skills that Product Builders use daily, encoding architectural standards, review logic and quality gates directly into the tools they run
  • Extend and improve the tribe's agentic tooling when it isn't good enough yet, since agentic development is the default way you build, not a fallback
  • Stay hands-on with the hardest technical problems: gnarly migrations, system-wide refactors and architecture calls that will shape years of future building
  • When work ships off-bar, trace it back to what was missing in the agents or patterns and fix it at the root so the same class of miss doesn't recur

AI Fluency Level 4: in this role that means building and shipping the engineering agents and skills that Product Builders rely on every day, not just using AI tools yourself. You need enough understanding of the underlying models and infrastructure to make real engineering decisions about them, because the agents you build become part of the tribe's production system.

For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to "AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates" on Confluence.

What you would bring 

  • A track record as a senior or staff-level engineer who has shipped and owned complex systems at scale, not just contributed to them
  • Experience turning hard-won technical judgment into reusable architecture, tooling or standards that other engineers actually adopt, rather than documentation that goes unused
  • Comfort holding a multi-cycle technical view (migrations, refactors, architecture decisions that play out over years) while still being able to drop into what needs to ship today
  • Clear communication across levels: builders, your Director, Principals and, when it counts, the C-suite
  • AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on experience: you've shipped something where AI is a core component and can make engineering decisions about the underlying models and infrastructure

Nice to have 

  • Experience in hospitality, travel or another operationally complex B2B SaaS environment
  • A track record of coaching or multiplying other engineers' output, not just your own
  • Public writing or speaking about technical work you've shipped

Pay Transparency at Mews

Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

What’s in it for you?

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

  • Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
  • Participation in our company share program
  • Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
  • An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
  • Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
  • A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
  • Relocation options, available after one year
  • Flexible, hybrid working options
  • A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance
  • Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

Local benefits

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

Life at Mews

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

  • High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.
  • Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.
  • We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.
  • AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.

We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.

One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.

If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

description: LA MAISON Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai. VOTRE RÔLE En tant que Conseiller(ère) de vente, vous serez ambassadeur / ambassadrice de la Maison et vous jouerez un rôle essentiel afin d’offrir à chaque client une expérience unique dans le respect et l’engagement de la Maison Jacquemus. Vous vous efforcerez de découvrir la personnalité de vos clients et d'identifier leurs désirs, tout en leur faisant découvrir l’ADN de la Maison et tous les univers produits. VOS MISSIONS · Participer activement au développement du chiffre d’affaires en accompagnant l’équipe dans l’atteinte des objectifs du point de vente. · Accueillir et conseiller nos clients pour leur offrir une expérience exceptionnelle. · Découvrir et partager votre expertise sur nos produits auprès des clients. · Faire preuve de proactivité en suggérant des produits complémentaires. · Contribuer à la fidélisation de notre clientèle en développant des relations privilégiées. · Assurer la bonne tenue du point de vente en collaboration avec l’équipe. · Participer aux missions opérationnelles : Visual merchandising, réassort, gestion des stocks, SAV. · Appliquer et respecter les procédures internes et guidelines. · Représenter l’esprit Jacquemus à travers votre créativité et votre sens de l’excellence. PROFIL · Étudiant(e) en école de commerce, de mode ou de management, avec une forte sensibilité pour l’univers de la mode et du luxe. · Première expérience en vente ou relation client appréciée. · Excellentes capacités de communication et sens du service client. · Enthousiaste, curieux(se) et doté(e) d’un esprit d’initiative. · Adaptable et proactif(ve), avec un fort esprit d’équipe. · Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, une troisième langue serait un plus. description: 24-38,75 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | Transformatie van Openbaar Bestuur | €600 | WO Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot Berenschot is op zoek naar een masterstudent die stage wil lopen bij de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur. Heb jij affiniteit met bestuurlijke vraagstukken en interesse in het adviesvak? Vind jij het leuk om mee te draaien in adviesprojecten en heb je een sterk organisatorisch vermogen? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou! Werken voor Berenschot betekent werken aan maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Wij helpen verschillende organisaties in het publieke domein met allerlei uitdagingen. Ook organiseren we regelmatig bijeenkomsten, kennissessies en meetings met een maatschappelijk tintje. Je leert veel over het dynamische speelveld waarin wij werken, doordat je direct meewerkt aan uitdagende opdrachten en een actieve bijdrage levert aan de genoemde activiteiten. Je komt terecht in een ambitieus en gedreven team met veel ervaring in het publieke domein. Dit team focust zich voornamelijk op strategie, samenwerking en organisatieontwikkeling in het openbaar bestuur. Zie je jezelf na de stage in het adviesvak? Dan zijn er mogelijkheden om te solliciteren op een traineeship. Dit ga je doen Overheden staan voor uiteenlopende uitdagingen, van de energietransitie tot het verbeteren van de woningmarkt. Berenschot helpt ministeries, provincies, gemeenten en waterschappen om deze uitdagingen aan te gaan. Als stagiair(e) draag je bij door: Mee te draaien met de Gideonsbende, waar je helpt bij de organisatie van leergangen en inspiratiesessies. Actief mee te werken aan opdrachten, zodat je het speelveld en de spelers binnen het publieke domein leert kennen. Samen met collega-consultants naar klanten te gaan en te leren van hun vraagstukken. Onderzoek te doen en vraagstukken te analyseren, ter ondersteuning van het advieswerk. Leermodules en events te organiseren, waarbij je contact onderhoudt met sprekers en locaties. Tijdens je stage word je intensief begeleid door een adviseur, zodat je je professionele vaardigheden ontwikkelt en leert hoe concepten en theorieën toegepast worden in de praktijk. Ook het uitvoeren van een afstudeeronderzoek is mogelijk. In dat geval bespreken we graag met elkaar hoe we het afstudeeronderzoek zo goed mogelijk kunnen laten aansluiten op ons advieswerk en vice versa. Quote "De kracht van samenwerking in het publieke domein inspireert mij dagelijks om innovatieve en waardevolle oplossingen te bieden voor maatschappelijke uitdagingen." – Senior consultant publieke sector Hier kom je terecht Berenschot is een onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid vanaf dag één krijg je de kans om te ontdekken waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen. Dit zijn je directe collega's Je gaat werken binnen de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur, specifiek in het team Strategie, Samenwerking en Organisatieontwikkeling. Dit team bestaat uit twintig gedreven adviseurs met specialisaties in bestuurskunde, rechten, technologie en innovatie. We houden ontwikkelingen in de maatschappij, politiek en economie nauwlettend in de gaten en schakelen direct in bij grote opgaven. We werken in wisselende teams, zodat altijd de juiste expertise beschikbaar is. Naast hard werken, wordt er veel gelachen. Binnen Berenschot hebben we een Gideonsbende: vrije denkers en jonge mensen die evenementen organiseren die normaal niet tot stand komen. Denk aan leergangen voor bestuurders en topambtenaren met de titel ‘Taaie thema’s en duivelse dilemma’s in het openbaar bestuur’. Daarnaast organiseren we onze eigen schaduwverkiezingen (inclusief uitslagenevenement) parallel aan die van de Tweede Kamer, provincies/Waterschappen of gemeenteraden. Verder organiseren wij allerlei andere bijeenkomsten, zoals een adviesmarathon voor het oplossen van vraagstukken van kleinere maatschappelijke organisaties. Dit neem je mee Je volgt een master (technische) bestuurskunde, management van de publieke sector, politicologie, bedrijfskunde, economie, sociologie of een vergelijkbare richting. Staat jouw studierichting hier niet bij, maar heb je wel affiniteit met het openbaar bestuur en een maatschappelijke drive? Solliciteer dan ook zeker! Je hebt een sterk conceptueel en analytisch vermogen, bent nieuwsgierig en staat stevig in je schoenen. Je bent creatief, goed in organiseren en werkt graag in teamverband. Je bent gedurende je stage ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling. Dit bieden we jou Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. We hebben een informele cultuur, korte communicatielijnen en volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele groei. Daarnaast bieden we: Een stagevergoeding van € 600,- bruto per maand op basis van fulltime. Een laptop. Persoonlijke begeleiding gericht op jouw professionele en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling. Een inspirerende werkplek in Utrecht en hybride werkmogelijkheden. Veel stagiairs zijn na hun stage aan een traineeship bij Berenschot begonnen – bij goed presteren biedt deze stage uitstekende kansen voor jouw carrière. Stageplusprogramma Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het Stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma . Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot Solliciteer meteen Wil jij ook een trotse Berenschotter worden? Solliciteer direct! Stuur je cv en motivatie naar Mariëlle Boer. Vragen?
